decision: retain isolated experiment as reviewed candidate; do not merge the five-step IRL1 into the default
reason: Weighted L1 clearly improves over plain on this suite and passes the predeclared numerical gate, but five-step IRL1 produces exactly the same coefficients and forecasts as one-pass adaptive L1 in all 21 paired configurations. Retain the evidence without introducing unnecessary iteration into the default. This is a review decision, not a claim that the frozen gate failed. Adaptive was not substituted post hoc as the predeclared promotion candidate.
review_scope_note: Independent new-IC structural gains occur in the estimated-pointwise variant. On the current integral pipeline the new analytic suite already gives plain 3/3; public integral improvements remain retrospective. This supports retaining a candidate rather than replacing the default now.
